americano.title: Americano
americano.howItWorks: Partners rotate every round, everyone plays everyone, most points wins. With the field in fours the schedule is exact: every pair partners once, and the rotation completes after players-minus-one rounds (7 rounds for 8 players); the next round starts over from round 1. Reserved players who haven't accepted yet count for round 1.

americano.howItWorksMexicano: Round 1 is random. From round 2 the courts follow the standings: the top four play on court 1, the next four on court 2, and on each court 1st and 4th play 2nd and 3rd. Enter every score before the next round.
americano.howItWorksKing: Winners move up a court, losers move down; the top court's winners and the bottom court's losers stay. Partners split every round. Standings follow the court you finish on, winners first. Enter every score before the next round.

about.title: The fine print, kept short
about.sub: No lawyers were harmed. Here's what Kicksmash does with your stuff.
about.storeBody: Your name, the matches you organize or join, scores and levels, and, only if you give them, your email and phone. If you sign in through Telegram or Discord we keep that account's id and username, nothing else from there. Your identity lives in a cookie on your device plus a private link, no password. A public page with your level exists only if you switch it on under My matches → Passport.
about.neverBody: Sell your data. Show ads. Email you for fun. Emails only go out for things you asked for: calendar invites, updates to matches you're in, reminders you switched on, and invitations an organizer sent you (with a one-tap 'never again' link).
about.cookiesBody: One functional cookie that remembers who you are, one for your language. No tracking, no third-party cookies, no banner needed.
about.rightsBody: Change your name or email anytime. Turn notifications off. Download everything we hold about you as one file from My matches → Passport. Delete your account from My matches: your personal data disappears, your old scores stay as 'Deleted player' so your friends' history still adds up.
about.termsBody: It's free. Be nice, show up, enter the score. The app comes as-is with no warranty; if a link breaks or a court double-books, that's between you and your padel buddies. We can remove abusive content or accounts.
about.openBody: Kicksmash is open source under the Apache 2.0 license. Read it, run it, build on it. The name and logo stay ours.

levels.title: What your padel level means
levels.sub: Kicksmash uses the 0 to 7 scale most padel apps use, in quarter steps. You declare it once; results move it a little; an organizer who played with you can confirm it.
levels.scaleNote: The same numbers Playtomic-style apps show, so a 3.0 here means what a 3.0 means at your club.
levels.rangesHelp: An organizer can set a range. Inside it people join; outside it they ask, and the organizer decides. Presets:
levels.faq1q: How do I know my level?
levels.faq1a: Read the scale above and pick the band that describes most of your matches, not your best day. Most people who play weekly and use the glass on purpose are 2.5 to 3.5. If unsure, pick the lower number: results correct it upwards.
levels.faq2q: How does the level change after matches?
levels.faq2a: Only when an organizer confirms a 2v2 score or finalizes a tournament. The change is small (at most ±{match} per match, ±{tournament} per tournament) and depends on the levels of everyone involved: beating stronger players moves you more. Unrated players never move anyone.
levels.faq3q: What is the tick next to a level?
levels.faq3a: An organizer who played with that person confirmed the level after the result. It stays while the level moves less than half a step. Rankings can rely on it.
levels.faq4a: It shows as a small chip next to your first name on matches you are in. Club and city rankings list you only if you switch that on yourself.
levels.ctaHelp: No account. Your name and level live behind a personal link.
levels.metaDescription: The padel level scale explained: what 0 to 7 means, how results move it, what a confirmed level is, and how level ranges work on a match.

calendar.lead: Every lesson already reaches your calendar. Each booking arrives in your email with an invitation, and a cancellation takes it out again. Tap it once and it is in Google, Apple or Outlook. Nothing below is needed for that.

coachFront.metaTitle: Padel coach? Your students book themselves
coachFront.metaDescription: A free assistant for padel coaches: one link, students book available times themselves, packages count themselves, cancellations follow your rules. Your Google Calendar stays yours. Set up in a minute.
coachFront.title: Your students book themselves. Your calendar stays yours.
coachFront.lead: One link for your students. They join once; from then on they book available times, cancel by your rules and see their package. You look at your calendar and it is already up to date. Nobody to reply to.
coachFront.ctaHelp: One minute. Free, no commission, no app.
coachFront.t1: “Is Friday at three free?” “How many lessons do I have left?” “Can we move tomorrow to five?” The assistant answers all of them, inside your rules, while you are on court. You hear about two things only, a new student and a time outside your hours, and both are one tap.
coachFront.t2: “6 of 10 left, 23 days” under every lesson. Expiry reminders go out by themselves. Paid is one tap for you.
coachFront.t3: Share your Google Calendar with our address and bookings appear there; what you write there blocks time here. Paste your package sheet once. Apple and Outlook work through an iCal link.
coachFront.t4: A PromptPay QR with the amount, or your own QR or payment link. We never touch a baht.
coachFront.t5: Your cutoff, one free late pass per package, then the lesson counts. A freed slot is offered to your waitlist for thirty minutes.
coachFront.t6: Your link and a QR for the fence, your Instagram bio, your club's page, and the city list if you choose to be listed. A student who coaches gets their own book from your page.
coachFront.telegram: Type “anna fri 15” and the lesson is booked, with an undo button. Your students write to the bot and get answers in their language while you are on court.
coachFront.founding: Kicksmash is free for every coach, and stays free. The first ten listed in each city also carry a founding badge on their page and a direct line to what we build next.
